#Preparar los datos
```{r warning=FALSE}
data_raw <- read_delim(
  "../data/data.csv",
  delim = ";",
  escape_double = FALSE,
  col_types = cols(fecha = col_date("%d/%m/%Y")),
  trim_ws = TRUE
)

data <- data_raw |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    year = year(fecha),
    month = month(fecha),
    month_factor = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = month.abb)
  )

tecnologias <- c(
  "hidraulica","nuclear","carbon","fuel_gas","ciclo_combinado",
  "eolica","solar_fotovoltaica","solar_termica","otras_renovables",
  "cogeneracion","residuos_no_renovables","residuos_renovables"
)

stopifnot(all(tecnologias %in% names(data)))
stopifnot("generacion_total" %in% names(data))

for (tec in tecnologias) {
  data[[paste0("share_", tec)]] <- data[[tec]] / data$generacion_total
}

renovables <- c(
  "hidraulica","eolica","solar_fotovoltaica","solar_termica",
  "otras_renovables","residuos_renovables"
)

fosiles <- c("carbon","fuel_gas","ciclo_combinado")

data <- data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    share_renovables = rowSums(across(paste0("share_", renovables))),
    share_fosiles = rowSums(across(paste0("share_", fosiles)))
  )

stopifnot(all(c(
  "mercado_diario_eur_mwh",
  "mercado_intradiario_eur_mwh",
  "precio_total_eur_mwh"
) %in% names(data)))

data <- data |>
  mutate(
    log_mercado_diario_eur_mwh = log(mercado_diario_eur_mwh),
    log_mercado_intradiario_eur_mwh = log(mercado_intradiario_eur_mwh),
    log_precio_total_eur_mwh = log(precio_total_eur_mwh),
    log_precio_gas_eur_mwh = log(precio_gas_natural_mwh)
  )

max_lag <- 12

data <- data |>
  mutate(
    crisis_gas = if_else(fecha >= ymd("2021-03-01") & fecha <= ymd("2023-05-31"), 1L, 0L),
    guerra_ucrania = if_else(fecha >= ymd("2022-02-01"), 1L, 0L),
    excepcion_iberica = if_else(fecha >= ymd("2022-06-01") & fecha <= ymd("2023-12-31"), 1L, 0L),
    covid = if_else(fecha >= ymd("2020-01-01") & fecha <= ymd("2022-05-01"), 1L, 0L)
  )

for (L in 1:max_lag) {
  data[[paste0("log_precio_total_lag", L)]] <- lag(data$log_precio_total_eur_mwh, L)
  data[[paste0("log_precio_gas_lag", L)]] <- lag(data$log_precio_gas_eur_mwh, L)
  data[[paste0("share_renovables_lag", L)]] <- lag(data$share_renovables, L)
  data[[paste0("share_fosiles_lag", L)]] <- lag(data$share_fosiles, L)
}

data <- data |>
  arrange(fecha) |>
  mutate(
    ma3_log_precio_total = rollmean(log_precio_total_eur_mwh, 3, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    ma6_log_precio_total = rollmean(log_precio_total_eur_mwh, 6, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    ma12_log_precio_total = rollmean(log_precio_total_eur_mwh, 12, fill = NA, align = "right")
  )

```

#EDA
```{r}

plot_ts <- function(data, var, title, ylab) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = fecha, y = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Fecha", y = ylab) +
    theme_minimal()
}

add_event_bands <- function() {
  list(
    annotate("rect",
      xmin = as.Date("2020-01-01"), xmax = as.Date("2022-05-01"),
      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.08, fill = "grey50"
    ),
    annotate("rect",
      xmin = as.Date("2022-06-01"), xmax = as.Date("2023-12-31"),
      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.10, fill = "blue"
    ),
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = as.Date("2022-02-01"),
      linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.7
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Librerías necesarias
library(GGally)
library(dplyr)


vars_corr <- c(
  "log_precio_total_eur_mwh", "share_hidraulica", "share_nuclear", "share_carbon",
  "share_ciclo_combinado", "share_eolica", "share_solar_fotovoltaica",
  "ipc_general", "precio_gas_natural_mwh"
)


corr_data <- data %>%
  select(any_of(vars_corr)) %>%
  drop_na()

# Matriz de correlaciones + gráfico ggpairs
if (ncol(corr_data) >= 2) {
  print(round(cor(corr_data), 2))  # matriz de correlación redondeada
  ggpairs(
    corr_data,
    title = "Matriz de correlaciones energéticas y de precios",
    upper = list(continuous = wrap("cor", size = 3)),
    lower = list(continuous = wrap("smooth", alpha = 0.3, size = 0.2)),
    diag = list(continuous = wrap("densityDiag"))
  ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
} else {
  message("No hay suficientes variables numéricas para el análisis de correlaciones.")
}
```

#VAR-SVAR
##Cointegrarion analysis
```{r include=FALSE}
data_grouped <- data |>
  mutate(
    renovables = share_hidraulica +
                 share_eolica +
                 share_solar_fotovoltaica +
                 share_solar_termica +
                 share_otras_renovables,
    fosiles = share_carbon +
              share_fuel_gas +
              share_ciclo_combinado +
              share_cogeneracion +
              share_residuos_no_renovables
  )

var_group_names <- c(
  "precio_total_eur_mwh",
  "precio_gas_natural_mwh",
  "renovables",
  "fosiles",
  "ipc_general"
)

stopifnot(all(var_group_names %in% names(data_grouped)))

Yg_df <- data_grouped |>
  arrange(fecha) |>
  dplyr::select(all_of(var_group_names))

Yg <- as.matrix(Yg_df)

cat("\nVariables agregadas incluidas:\n")
print(var_group_names)
cat("\nN observaciones:", nrow(Yg_df), "\n\n")

cat("### TESTS DE RAÍCES UNITARIAS (ADF y KPSS) – AGREGADOS ###\n")

for (v in var_group_names) {
  serie <- Yg_df[[v]]

  cat("\n--------------------------\n")
  cat("Variable:", v, "\n")

  adf_drift <- ur.df(serie, type = "drift", lags = 12)
  cat("\nADF (constante):\n")
  print(summary(adf_drift))

  adf_trend <- ur.df(serie, type = "trend", lags = 12)
  cat("\nADF (tendencia):\n")
  print(summary(adf_trend))

  kpss_mu <- ur.kpss(serie, type = "mu", lags = "short")
  cat("\nKPSS nivel:\n")
  print(summary(kpss_mu))

  kpss_tau <- ur.kpss(serie, type = "tau", lags = "short")
  cat("\nKPSS tendencia:\n")
  print(summary(kpss_tau))
}

cat("\n### SELECCIÓN DE RETARDOS (VARselect) – AGREGADOS ###\n")

pmax <- 12

lag_selection_g <- VARselect(
  Yg,
  lag.max = pmax,
  type = "const"
)

print(lag_selection_g$selection)
cat("\nCriterios completos:\n")
print(lag_selection_g$criteria)

cat("\n### TEST DE COINTEGRACIÓN DE JOHANSEN – AGREGADOS ###\n")

K_diff <- 2

jo_trace_g <- ca.jo(
  Yg,
  type = "trace",
  ecdet = "const",
  K = K_diff,
  spec = "transitory"
)

cat("\nResumen test traza (agregados):\n")
print(summary(jo_trace_g))

jo_eigen_g <- ca.jo(
  Yg,
  type = "eigen",
  ecdet = "const",
  K = K_diff,
  spec = "transitory"
)

cat("\nResumen test eigen (agregados):\n")
print(summary(jo_eigen_g))

dummies_mes <- model.matrix(~ month_factor, data = data_grouped)[ , -1]

Xg <- cbind(
  dummies_mes
  ##crisis_gas        = data_grouped$crisis_gas,
  ##guerra_ucrania    = data_grouped$guerra_ucrania,
  #excepcion_iberica = data_grouped$excepcion_iberica,
  ##covid             = data_grouped$covid
)

diagnostics_grouped <- list(
  var_group_names   = var_group_names,
  Yg                = Yg,
  lag_selection_g   = lag_selection_g,
  johansen_trace_g  = jo_trace_g,
  johansen_eigen_g  = jo_eigen_g,
  Xg                = Xg
)

```

##SVAR Model: Choelsky Identification
```{r}
order_g <- c(
  "precio_gas_natural_mwh",
  "renovables",
  "fosiles",
  "precio_total_eur_mwh",
  "ipc_general"
)

Yg_chol <- Yg_df[, order_g]

varg_chol <- VAR(Yg_chol, p = p_g, type = "const", exogen = Xg)
```


```{r}
set.seed(123)
irf_g <- irf(
  varg_chol,
  impulse = colnames(Yg_chol),
  response = colnames(Yg_chol),
  n.ahead = 12,
  ortho = TRUE,
  boot = TRUE,
  runs = 5000,
  ci=0.95
)
```


```{r}
plot_irf_base <- function(irf_obj, shock_var) {

  if (!(shock_var %in% names(irf_obj$irf))) stop("Shock no existe.")

  irf_mat <- irf_obj$irf[[shock_var]]
  low_mat <- irf_obj$Lower[[shock_var]]
  up_mat  <- irf_obj$Upper[[shock_var]]

  responses <- colnames(irf_mat)
  n_resp <- length(responses)

  ncol <- min(3, n_resp)
  nrow <- ceiling(n_resp / ncol)

  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(old_par))

  par(mfrow = c(nrow, ncol), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))

  for (resp in responses) {
    ir <- irf_mat[, resp]
    lo <- low_mat[, resp]
    up <- up_mat[, resp]
    h  <- 0:(length(ir) - 1)
    ylim <- range(c(lo, up, ir), na.rm = TRUE)

    plot(
      h, ir, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
      main = paste("Shock en", shock_var, "\nRespuesta:", resp),
      xlab = "Horizonte (meses)", ylab = "IRF", ylim = ylim
    )

    polygon(
      c(h, rev(h)),
      c(lo, rev(up)),
      col = rgb(0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.25),
      border = NA
    )

    abline(h = 0, col = "gray40", lty = 2)
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}

plot_irf_base(irf_g, "precio_gas_natural_mwh")
plot_irf_base(irf_g, "fosiles")
plot_irf_base(irf_g, "renovables")
plot_irf_base(irf_g, "precio_total_eur_mwh")
plot_irf_base(irf_g, "ipc_general")
```


```{r}
fevd_g <- fevd(varg_chol, n.ahead = 24)

plot_fevd <- function(fevd_obj) {
  df <- purrr::map_dfr(names(fevd_obj), function(var) {
    mat <- fevd_obj[[var]]
    as.data.frame(mat) |>
      mutate(
        horizon = 1:nrow(mat),
        variable = var
      )
  }) |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(horizon, variable),
      names_to = "shock",
      values_to = "value"
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = horizon, y = value, fill = shock)) +
    geom_area(position = "stack") +
    facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(
      title = "FEVD (Cholesky)",
      x = "Horizonte",
      y = "Contribución (%)"
    )
}

plot_fevd(fevd_g)

```

##Forecasting
```{r}
data_grouped <- data_grouped |> arrange(fecha)

train <- data_grouped |> filter(year(fecha) <= 2023)
test  <- data_grouped |> filter(year(fecha) == 2024)

var_names <- c(
  "precio_gas_natural_mwh",
  "renovables",
  "fosiles",
  "precio_total_eur_mwh",
  "ipc_general"
)

Y_train <- train |> dplyr::select(all_of(var_names)) |> as.matrix()
Y_test  <- test  |> dplyr::select(all_of(var_names)) |> as.matrix()

# ============================
# 2. Exogenous 
# ============================

d_train <- model.matrix(~ month_factor, data = train)[ , -1]
d_test  <- model.matrix(~ month_factor, data = test)[ , -1]

X_train <- cbind(
  d_train
  #crisis_gas        = train$crisis_gas,
  #guerra_ucrania    = train$guerra_ucrania,
  #excepcion_iberica = train$excepcion_iberica
  ##covid             = train$covid
)

X_test <- cbind(
  d_test
  #crisis_gas        = test$crisis_gas,
  #guerra_ucrania    = test$guerra_ucrania,
  #excepcion_iberica = test$excepcion_iberica
  #covid             = test$covid
)

# ============================
# 3.  lag +  VAR
# ============================

lags <- VARselect(Y_train, lag.max = 12, type = "const", exogen = X_train)
p_f<- lags$selection[["HQ(n)"]]

var_fit <- VAR(Y_train, p = 6, type = "const", exogen = X_train)

# ============================
# 4. Forecast 2024
# ============================

fc <- predict(var_fit, n.ahead = nrow(test), dumvar = X_test)

# Convert to matrix
fc_mean <- do.call(cbind, lapply(fc$fcst, function(x) x[,"fcst"]))
fc_low  <- do.call(cbind, lapply(fc$fcst, function(x) x[,"lower"]))
fc_up   <- do.call(cbind, lapply(fc$fcst, function(x) x[,"upper"]))

colnames(fc_mean) <- paste0(var_names, ".fc_mean")
colnames(fc_low)  <- paste0(var_names, ".fc_low")
colnames(fc_up)   <- paste0(var_names, ".fc_up")


pred_df <- data.frame(
  fecha = test$fecha,
  fc_mean,
  fc_low,
  fc_up
)

# ============================
# 5. Errores MAPE + RMSE
# ============================

errors <- data.frame(
  variable = var_names,
  RMSE = sapply(var_names, function(v) rmse(test[[v]], pred_df[[paste0(v, ".fc_mean")]])),
  MAPE = sapply(var_names, function(v) mape(test[[v]], pred_df[[paste0(v, ".fc_mean")]]))
)

print(errors)
```

```{r}
plot_fan <- function(var) {

  fc_mean <- paste0(var, ".fc_mean")
  fc_low  <- paste0(var, ".fc_low")
  fc_up   <- paste0(var, ".fc_up")

  ggplot(pred_df, aes(x = fecha)) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = .data[[fc_low]], ymax = .data[[fc_up]]),
      fill = "#A6CEE3", alpha = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[fc_mean]]), color = "#1F78B4", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_line(data = test, aes(y = .data[[var]]), color = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Forecast", var, "(2024)"),
      x = "", y = ""
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

for (v in var_names) {
  print(plot_fan(v))
}


```



```{r}
plot_history_forecast <- function(var) {

  fc_mean <- paste0(var, ".fc_mean")

  ggplot() +
    # Histórico completo
    geom_line(data = data_grouped, aes(x = fecha, y = .data[[var]]),
              color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.8) +

    # Forecast media
    geom_line(data = pred_df, aes(x = fecha, y = .data[[fc_mean]]),
              color = "#1F78B4", linewidth = 1.2) +

    # Observado 2024
    geom_line(data = test, aes(x = fecha, y = .data[[var]]),
              color = "black", linewidth = 1.0) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Serie histórica + Forecast de", var),
      x = "", y = ""
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

for (v in var_names) {
```

#ML: XGBoost for TS
```{r}
# =======================================================================================
# 1. FUNCIONES AUXILIARES
# =======================================================================================

make_lags <- function(df, vars, L = 12){
  for(v in vars){
    if (!v %in% names(df)) next
    for(l in 1:L){
      df[[paste0(v, "_lag", l)]] <- dplyr::lag(df[[v]], l)
    }
  }
  df
}

rmse <- function(a,p){ sqrt(mean((a-p)^2, na.rm=TRUE)) }
mape <- function(a,p){ mean(abs((a-p)/a), na.rm=TRUE) * 100 }

safe_predict <- function(model, newdata){
  suppressWarnings(predict(model, newdata = as.data.frame(newdata)))
}

# =======================================================================================
# 2. VARIABLES DEL MODELO
# =======================================================================================

share_cols <- grep("^share_", names(data), value = TRUE)

control_cols <- c("crisis_gas","guerra_ucrania","covid","excepcion_iberica")

target_price <- "precio_total_eur_mwh"
target_ipc   <- "ipc_general"

data_base <- data %>% arrange(fecha)

if ("month_factor" %in% names(data_base)){
  data_base <- data_base %>% mutate(month_factor = as.numeric(month_factor))
}
```

## Modelo de Precio de la Electricidad
```{r}
price_feats_base <- c(
  share_cols,
  "precio_gas_natural_mwh",
  control_cols,
  "month_factor"
)

lag_vars_price <- c(
  target_price,
  target_ipc,
  share_cols,
  "precio_gas_natural_mwh",
  control_cols
)

dat_price <- data_base %>%
  dplyr::select(fecha, all_of(c(target_price, price_feats_base))) %>%
  make_lags(lag_vars_price, 12) %>%
  drop_na()

cutoff_date <- as.Date("2023-12-01")
train_price <- dat_price %>% filter(fecha <= cutoff_date)
test_price  <- dat_price %>% filter(fecha >  cutoff_date)

x_price_cols <- setdiff(names(train_price), c("fecha", target_price))

x_price_train <- as.matrix(train_price[, x_price_cols])
y_price_train <- train_price[[target_price]]

x_price_test  <- as.matrix(test_price[, x_price_cols])
y_price_test  <- test_price[[target_price]]

cat("Train:", nrow(x_price_train),"   Test:", nrow(x_price_test),"\n")
```


```{r}
# =======================================================================================
# 4. ENTRENAMIENTO ROLLING WINDOW (PRECIO)
# =======================================================================================

n_train <- nrow(train_price)

slices <- createTimeSlices(
  1:n_train,
  initialWindow = floor(0.6*n_train),
  horizon       = floor(0.2*n_train),
  fixedWindow   = TRUE
)

ctrl_price <- trainControl(
  method        = "cv",
  index         = slices$train,
  indexOut      = slices$test,
  allowParallel = TRUE
)

grid_price <- expand.grid(
  nrounds          = c(150,300),
  max_depth        = c(2,3),
  eta              = c(0.05,0.1),
  gamma            = 0,
  colsample_bytree = c(0.7,0.9),
  min_child_weight = c(1,3),
  subsample        = c(0.7,0.9)
)

cl <- makeCluster(max(1,detectCores()-1))
registerDoParallel(cl)

set.seed(123)
fit_price <- caret::train(
  x = x_price_train,
  y = y_price_train,
  method    = "xgbTree",
  trControl = ctrl_price,
  tuneGrid  = grid_price,
  metric    = "RMSE",
  
)

stopCluster(cl)
registerDoSEQ()

fit_price
```


```{r}
pred_price_test <- predict(fit_price, x_price_test)

rmse_price <- rmse(y_price_test, pred_price_test)
mape_price <- mape(y_price_test, pred_price_test)

metrics_price <- data.frame(variable="precio_total_eur_mwh",
                            RMSE=rmse_price,
                            MAPE=mape_price)
metrics_price

# Fan chart
pred_train <- predict(fit_price, x_price_train)
sigma_price <- sd(y_price_train - pred_train)

fan_price <- test_price %>%
  dplyr::select(fecha, precio_total_eur_mwh) %>%
  mutate(
    fc_mean = pred_price_test,
    fc_low  = fc_mean - 1.64*sigma_price,
    fc_up   = fc_mean + 1.64*sigma_price
  )
```

```{r}
plot_pdp_pct1 <- function(v, model_iml, data_full, target_name) {

  message("Generando PDP/ICE (%): ", v)

  # --- calcular efecto marginal ---
  eff <- iml::FeatureEffect$new(
    model_iml,
    feature   = v,
    method    = "pdp+ice",
    grid.size = 30
  )

  df <- eff$results
  
  # Asegurar columna con predicciones
  ycol <- intersect(colnames(df), c("yhat","prediction",".value","response"))[1]

  if (!(".id" %in% colnames(df))) {
    df$.id <- rep(seq_len(nrow(df) / length(unique(df[[v]]))),
                  each = length(unique(df[[v]])))
  }

  # Precio base: promedio real
  base_price <- mean(data_full[[target_name]], na.rm = TRUE)

  # Convertir a % de cambio
  df$y_pct <- 100 * (df[[ycol]] - base_price) / base_price

  # PDP
  pdp_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[v]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(y_pct = mean(y_pct))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[v]], y = y_pct)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = .id), alpha = 0.15, color = "grey50") +   # ICE
    geom_line(data = pdp_df, color = "#E69F00", linewidth = 1.4) +  # PDP
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-10, 10)) + 
    labs(
      title = paste0("Efecto marginal (%): ", v),
      x = v,
      y = "% cambio en precio predicho"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

plot_pdp_pct2 <- function(v, model_iml, data_full, target_name) {

  message("Generando PDP/ICE (%): ", v)

  # --- calcular efecto marginal ---
  eff <- iml::FeatureEffect$new(
    model_iml,
    feature   = v,
    method    = "pdp+ice",
    grid.size = 30
  )

  df <- eff$results
  

  ycol <- intersect(colnames(df), c("yhat","prediction",".value","response"))[1]

  if (!(".id" %in% colnames(df))) {
    df$.id <- rep(seq_len(nrow(df) / length(unique(df[[v]]))),
                  each = length(unique(df[[v]])))
  }

  # Precio base: promedio real
  base_price <- mean(data_full[[target_name]], na.rm = TRUE)

  # Convertir a % de cambio
  df$y_pct <- 100 * (df[[ycol]] - base_price) / base_price

  # PDP
  pdp_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[v]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(y_pct = mean(y_pct))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[v]], y = y_pct)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = .id), alpha = 0.15, color = "grey50") +   # ICE
    geom_line(data = pdp_df, color = "#E69F00", linewidth = 1.4) +  # PDP
    labs(
      title = paste0("Efecto marginal (%): ", v),
      subtitle = "ICE (gris) y PDP (línea amarilla)",
      x = v,
      y = "% cambio en precio predicho"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

## Modelo de IPC
```{r}
ipc_feats_base <- c(
  share_cols,
  "precio_gas_natural_mwh",
  control_cols,
  "month_factor"
)

lag_vars_ipc <- c(
  target_ipc,
  target_price,
  share_cols,
  "precio_gas_natural_mwh",
  control_cols
)

dat_ipc <- data_base %>%
  dplyr::select(fecha, all_of(c(target_ipc, ipc_feats_base, target_price))) %>%
  make_lags(lag_vars_ipc, 12) %>%
  drop_na()

train_ipc <- dat_ipc %>% filter(fecha <= cutoff_date)
test_ipc  <- dat_ipc %>% filter(fecha >  cutoff_date)

x_ipc_cols <- setdiff(names(train_ipc), c("fecha", target_ipc))

# X matrices
x_ipc_train <- as.matrix(train_ipc[, x_ipc_cols])
x_ipc_test  <- as.matrix(test_ipc[, x_ipc_cols])

# Y vectores 
y_ipc_train <- train_ipc[[target_ipc]]
y_ipc_test  <- test_ipc[[target_ipc]]

# Rolling window IPC
slices_ipc <- createTimeSlices(
  1:nrow(train_ipc),
  initialWindow = floor(0.6*nrow(train_ipc)),
  horizon       = floor(0.2*nrow(train_ipc)),
  fixedWindow   = TRUE
)

ctrl_ipc <- trainControl(
  method="cv",
  index=slices_ipc$train,
  indexOut=slices_ipc$test,
  allowParallel=TRUE
)

grid_ipc <- grid_price

cl2 <- makeCluster(max(1,detectCores()-1))
registerDoParallel(cl2)

set.seed(123)
fit_ipc <- caret::train(
  x = x_ipc_train,
  y = y_ipc_train,
  method="xgbTree",
  trControl = ctrl_ipc,
  tuneGrid  = grid_ipc,
  metric    = "RMSE"
)

stopCluster(cl2)
registerDoSEQ()

pred_ipc_test <- predict(fit_ipc, x_ipc_test)

metrics_ipc <- data.frame(
  variable="ipc_general",
  RMSE = rmse(y_ipc_test, pred_ipc_test),
  MAPE = mape(y_ipc_test, pred_ipc_test)
)

metrics_ipc
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, dpi=200}
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(stringr)

vars_all <- vars_ipc_to_plot1_f

plots_pdp <- lapply(vars_all, function(v){

  if (!v %in% colnames(X_ipc_interpret)) {
    message("Variable no usada por IPC: ", v)
    return(NULL)
  }

  p <- plot_pdp_pct1(
    v           = v,
    model_iml   = pred_ipc_iml,
    data_full   = dat_ipc,
    target_name = target_ipc
  ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-5, 5)) +
    labs(
      title = str_replace(v, "^share_", ""),  # título corto
      x = NULL, y = NULL
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 7),
      plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6)
    )

  p
})

plots_pdp <- Filter(Negate(is.null), plots_pdp)

p_grid <- wrap_plots(plots_pdp, ncol = 3) +   
  plot_annotation(title = "% de cambio predicho en IPC - Efectos marginales: PDP (amarillo) / ICE (gris)" ) &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

p_grid

```
